prompt:
Edit this production floor texture sheet, preserving the EXACT 4 columns by 2 rows, eight equal square cells, 2:1 overall canvas, full opaque coverage with NO gutters or borders, and each cell's existing colour/material identity. This is the final low-contrast floor pass for a survival game. Remove ALL large cracks, long diagonal streaks, circles, vein networks, pronounced lines, broad dark/light patches and other recognizable repeating shapes from every cell. Replace those features with quiet evenly distributed small granular surface texture and tiny scattered irregular flakes. Each individual fleck should be only 1–6 pixels at full sheet scale. Texture should look organic, hand-painted and worn, NOT a flat colour and NOT evenly patterned dots. No directional grain. Keep colours muted and approximately the same mid-dark value. Lighting completely uniform. Edges and middle must have the same typical grain and brightness. These tiles will be repeated with mirrored sampling, so NOTHING in them should form a recognizable symmetric shape when reflected.
Cell identities unchanged: top row grey-brown compacted silt; grey-olive fungal soil; grey-tan fine paper pulp fibers; charcoal basalt ash. Bottom row cool slate limestone dust; olive-grey wet sediment with only tiny moisture flecks; smoky mauve-grey resin dust; cool grey-brown reservoir silt. Subtle textural differences, no props, no stones larger than fine gravel, no paper scraps, no puddle shapes, no figures, no text. Crisp painted pixel detail matching the original.
